decision_record.calculation: Measured: entry drive -> 1 entry (oracle-matched). Same fixture with the quote aged ~300s -> 0 entries (fresh-quote gate binds). Same fixture with the quote spread widened to ~1075bps -> 0 entries (spread gate binds). Bar-cursor-not-ready -> 0 entries (oracle refusal drive). Stop-exit drive -> oracle-matched exit.
decision_record.comparison: First look examined: entry pricing currency, quote freshness, spread discipline, exit field starvation, bar integrity.
decision_record.experiment: Evidence drives in tests/test_edge_batch14_blockers.py::TestVerifyOnlyEvidence::test_bb_rsi_gates_bind plus the port suite's entry/stop-exit/cursor-refusal oracle drives.
decision_record.mechanism: No change. Every candidate leak is already gated at the sleeve's own constants, with traces: entries require a quote <= 60s old (QUOTE_MAX_AGE_S), spread <= 15bps, R:R >= 1.2 recomputed on that live quote, a ready bar cursor, no intraday gap in the recent frame, and a bar <= 600s old (BAR_MAX_AGE_S) — the stale-input class is closed at tighter bounds than this program's adapter gates. Exits read stop/target/entry-bar from the adapter-recorded entry plan (no capitulation-style field starvation), and the entry intent itself carries stop/target/time ExitRules for the dispatcher.
decision_record.transfer: Confirmed BB-touch RSI divergences on hourly closes, entered at a limit priced off a live quote, exited at the adapter-recorded plan (stop/target/24-bar time). The expansion (X1-X4) is the sleeve's defining change and was owner-ordered at install.

verdict: VERIFY-ONLY — no binding leak survives scrutiny
